video_title: The 6k Monitor Apple Doesn't Want You To Find
evidence: SponsorRadar records ClickClack sponsoring Better Creating's August 21, 2026 English-language YouTube video. Better Creating has about 264K subscribers. ClickClack's official contact page explicitly invites collaborations and partnerships with creators, designers and brands and publishes partnership@clickclack.io for those inquiries, separately from customer support.
